set.prevailing_wage_basis: 24 CFR 983.153(c)(2): for PBV development activity (new construction or rehabilitation) involving nine or more contract units, the owner and its contractors must pay Davis-Bacon wages; the PHA monitors compliance. Existing-housing PBV contracts with no development activity do not trigger it. https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/24/983.153
set.audit_note: Tier 4 spot check November 9, 2026: OCHA project-based page matches the 2026 Supportive Housing NOFA offer of up to 100 HCV, Mainstream or VASH PBVs (150 under the 2025 NOFA) and the pipeline (Lincoln Avenue Buena Park 13 PBV, Avon River 24 plus 10 VASH preferences, Orion 8 senior units, Cartwright 8, Oasis 62). Prevailing wage changed from false to true because the record covers new construction and acquisition-rehab and 24 CFR 983.153(c) requires Davis-Bacon at nine or more PBV contract units in development.

reason: Material: prevailing_wage_trigger false is contradicted by 24 CFR 983.153(c) Davis-Bacon at 9 or more PBV contract units for new construction or rehab, which the record lists as eligible.

set.typical_award_size: HCD 2024-2028 Formula Allocation NOFA: Orange County CY 2024 $892,973, CY 2025 $956,505, five-year estimate $5,581,081. The County's amended PLHA Five-Year Plan (Attachment A-C-E, December 2023 NOFA) uses only Sections 301(a)(6) and 301(a)(7): about 88% for homelessness activities (45% Buena Park and Placentia navigation centers via the North SPA collaborative, 32% regional emergency shelters such as the Yale Transitional Center for the unincorporated area and Laguna Hills, 4% Laguna Beach case management and supportive services, 7% Dana Point outreach and rapid rehousing), 7% for accessibility modifications in low-income senior owner-occupied homes in Laguna Woods (3%) and Seal Beach (4%), and 5% administration. The plan marks 301(a)(1) rental housing development and 301(a)(2) workforce housing as not selected, so no PLHA development money is offered to developers.
set.affordability_requirement: All PLHA-assisted households at or below 60% AMI under the County plan (shelter and navigation center clients counted at 30% AMI; accessibility modification recipients at or below 60% AMI). No rental development covenants because the plan funds no development.
eligible_project_detail: navigation center and emergency shelter capital and operations
homeless supportive services and rapid rehousing
accessibility modifications for low-income senior owner-occupied homes

reason: Material: typical_award_size, affordability_requirement and eligible_project_types wrongly showed an 11.45% rental development share; the County plan funds only homelessness activities and owner-occupied accessibility modifications at or below 60% AMI.
